newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down six cents to 14.05 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down six cents to 14.05 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell six cents to 14.05 ringgit ($5.60) a kg after players took their cue from an overnight fall on London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
Late buying at lower levels ahead of Thursday's Labour Day holiday, kept the price from slipping too much, they said.
"The LME triggered selling but there was support from pre-holiday buying," said a trader.

Initial offers totalled 120 tonnes against bids of 79. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. Turnover rose to 110 tonnes from 88 tonnes on Tuesday. The premium over the LME widened widened to $100 from $70.
